intro: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken soldier stationed just outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He sizes up newly risen Forsaken and sends them to raid the human pumpkin farm to the west, patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade, for reagents the apothecaries of Brill need.

p: Posted just outside Deathknell, Deathguard Simmer represents the Forsaken military line holding the border between the safe haven of Deathknell and the wider perils of Tirisfal Glades. The region crawls with living humans—most notably the fanatical Scarlet Crusade—who view all undead as abominations to be purged with fire and blade. Simmer tests fledgling Forsaken by sending them west to the Solliden Farmstead, where the Scarlet Crusade patrols from its nearby tower, to steal ten pumpkins and carry them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
